exec_command.description: The command and its arguments to execute and log.

syslog_facility.description: The syslog facility to use (e.g. daemon, local0, local4).

pid_file.description: Path to the file where the child process ID is written. If empty, no PID file is created.

fd_levels.description: List of file descriptor level mappings. Uses flat items map.

fd_levels_items.description: Internal structure for fd_levels. Map 'fd' to file descriptor number (1 or 2) and 'level' to syslog priority (e.g. info, err, crit).
